purpose: Corrected silent-application baseline for two different workloads, not a framework before/after speedup comparison. Static row versus Effect.succeed data-id per row.
guardRed: Old Effect-property fixture emits 11,976 console messages during one-row removal; the new guard rejects it.

research.title: Dapper, a Large-Scale Distributed Systems Tracing Infrastructure
research.use: Low instrumentation overhead and limiting active instrumentation motivate explicit measurement of telemetry cost, not importing distributed tracing sampling policies into cleanup.

research.title: Pivot Tracing: Dynamic Causal Monitoring for Distributed Systems
research.use: Causal correlation and in-request aggregation motivate the future wide-event audit; no numeric transfer from its distributed-system benchmarks to browser UI.

decision: Fix the benchmark configuration and enforce zero console messages for every measured/warmup operation. All 36 operation/run pairs passed. Core source and built JS are unchanged. These new silent baselines supersede older absolute timings as optimization references; old logged runs remain historical evidence.
